Calcula el FDR, compara desarrollos y en: Calculate FDR, compare gearing and find a pinion for your next change.
La relación interna es la reducción entr: The internal ratio is the reduction between the spur and the wheels. Check your manual; use 1 only if there is no further reduction.
FDR = (corona ÷ piñón) × relación intern: FDR = (spur ÷ pinion) × internal ratio. A higher FDR means shorter gearing.
El avance es la distancia teórica recorr: Rollout is the theoretical distance travelled per motor revolution: π × tyre diameter ÷ FDR. It lets you compare setups with different tyres.
Los valores iniciales son un ejemplo, no: The initial values are an example, not a recommendation. Enter your car’s values.
Los cálculos no comprueban que un piñón: The calculations do not check pinion fit or motor and ESC thermal limits. Tyre deformation and slip are not included.
